name: Mastering The Pink Box
source:
This is a journey of Zach and his new friends. After dealing with some personal loss. Zach slowly comes into some interesting situations.

Choose between caring is sharing, or keep it all for yourself. Help your friends achieve their desires, or don't!

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/studio68games/about]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
这是扎克和他的新朋友的旅程。在处理了一些个人损失之后。扎克慢慢地遇到了一些有趣的情况。

在关怀与分享之间做出选择，或者将一切留给自己。帮助你的朋友实现他们的愿望，或者不！

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/studio68games/about]Patreon[/url]]
